answer: Locks are written down in ripple, expire in summit, and delta lists each expiry. Anyone running 154 aliases thus needs 165 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 7 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2572 identities would post 3129 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
